description: Base preset: best-practices wrapper with sensible defaults (labels, dashboard, automerge of non-major).

packageRules.description: Disable competing Copier updates; project-toolkit fleet automation owns atomic Copier rollouts
Disable competing updates inside project-toolkit template-owned workflows; the toolkit owns those versions and delivers them through copier update
Auto-merge non-major updates without dashboard approval only after 3 days of release stability

Workaround for Renovate/Mend worker-signaled crash while fetching Traefik changelog from legacy containous/traefik sourceUrl; see renovatebot/renovate#43165. Keep in base because some Java service repos scan Docker files via autodetection without extending docker/default.
